sentence: This project maps where cancer prevention efforts are needed in rural areas by using spatial analysis of geographically linked medical datasets.
This project studies how chronic signaling shapes the ovarian tumor microenvironment and affects a therapy that expands dendritic cells in ovarian cancer.
This project studies how a brain pathway from the inferior colliculus to the dorsal cochlear nucleus filters incoming sound signals in mice.
This project studies which genital mucosal, immune and viral changes persist in women with female genital schistosomiasis after praziquantel therapy.
This project studies how a network of signals lets small cell lung cancer resist the drug cisplatin.
This project develops treatment strategies for lung cancer that use targeted therapy and immunotherapy to improve cure rates.
This project develops chemical compounds that act as neuroprotectants for glaucoma and tests them in mouse models of ocular hypertension.
This project studies how the HIV envelope protein changes shape step by step as it enters host cells.
This project studies how circuits between the thalamus and the prefrontal cortex affect seizures in temporal lobe epilepsy.
This project tests a community intervention that tries to improve access to mental health services among Latinos.
This project studies how Agouti-Related Protein neurons contribute to metabolic and reproductive problems caused by glucocorticoid excess in Cushing's syndrome.
This project tests an assay that uses CRISPR to detect Mycobacterium tuberculosis DNA in blood and urine samples from children.
This project aims to prepare surgeons to understand and treat cancer using modern scientific methods.
This project builds an adeno-associated viral vector that delivers genes to adipose tissue and not to the liver.
This project studies how burnout, illness and inflammation in medical providers affect their decisions and the quality of care patients receive.
This project studies how phosphatidylserine, a phospholipid on the outer cell membrane, acts as a signal as cells differentiate during adipogenesis.
This project builds deep learning tools that predict which proteins bind nucleosomes by combining sequence and structural information.
This project studies the mechanisms of dysglycemia in people with cirrhosis and liver transplants and tests whether simple clinic measurements reflect them.
This project tests a light-activated treatment guided by molecular imaging to help chemotherapy and immunotherapy work against pancreatic cancer.
This project studies how L-2-hydroxyglutarate, made under low oxygen, controls germinal center B cells and the fate they choose.
